items.name: Fight Club
items.desc: this guy hates his job, thinks everything is shit and gets off on going to help groups to see sad people. He meets this fella on a flight and ends up starting a fight club with him. Antics ensue.

items.name: Legend
items.desc: Based on the Kray Twins (infamous gangsters of London?) I think it's London I forgot. Anyways Tom Hardy does a masterclass in this film, I'd recommend it. It's all about the twins rise to the top and their downfall.

items.name: Sinners
items.desc: It follows twin brothers Smoke and Stack Moore, played by Michael B. Jordan, returning to Jim Crow Mississippi in 1932 from Chicago's criminal underworld to build a new life by opening a juke joint, but they find themselves confronting both deep-seated racism and a looming supernatural threat that even their street smarts can't handle, forcing them to face dangers that challenge their dreams of freedom and redemption.
